segments.thag4.10:1.1: [jā.1.10.102 jātakepi]“Dhammo have rakkhati dhammacāriṃ, dhammo suciṇṇo sukhamāvahati;
segments.thag4.10:1.3: Esānisaṃso dhamme suciṇṇe, na duggatiṃ gacchati dhammacārī.
segments.thag4.10:2.3: Adhammo nirayaṃ neti, dhammo pāpeti suggatiṃ.
segments.thag4.10:3.1: “Tasmā hi dhammesu kareyya chandaṃ, iti modamāno sugatena tādinā;
segments.thag4.10:3.3: Dhamme ṭhitā sugatavarassa sāvakā, nīyanti dhīrā saraṇavaraggagāmino.
